'''Quick''' is the name of [[Davram Bashere]]'s horse.

==Appearance==
Quick is a bay horse.

==Activities==
Quick carries Davram Bashere during a battle with the [[Seanchan]]{{ref/book|8|24}} and as Bashere scouts [[Arymilla Marne]] camp near [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|10|Prologue}}
